name: 🥤 Power Protein Smoothie
what: A thick, cold blender smoothie with yogurt, frozen fruit and OJ.
early: Optional, Sunday: freeze ripe banana chunks.

core.name: Frozen berries
core.out: any frozen fruit, or fresh + ice

extras: bananas, baby spinach, honey, peanut butter

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Into the blender: 1½ cups OJ, then 2 cups yogurt.
Spinach and banana, then the frozen berries on top.
Blend low, then high, until smooth.
Taste. Too thick? More juice. Not sweet? Honey.

key: Liquids in first, frozen fruit last, so the blender doesn't jam.
done: Smooth, no chunks, and thick enough to hold a straw.
plan_b: No frozen fruit? Yogurt parfaits or a banana with peanut butter.
